quizName:
Hardest Questions in Utah
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What can impair a person's ability to drive?
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs (legal and illegal), and drowsiness can all impair your driving.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers make many decisions while driving. Any extra activity can be dangerous. Keep your full attention on the road.

questions.question: What should you do before turning?
questions.explanation: Turn on your signal three to four seconds before you turn. This warns other drivers of your intention.

questions.question: What should you do when facing an aggressive driver?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove of their behavior.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and create distance between your vehicle and theirs. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or gestures.

questions.question: What should you do after a serious car crash?
questions.explanation: Move off the road if possible and stop. If anyone is hurt, call 911. Report the crash to police if there are injuries, deaths, or property damage over $1,000.

questions.question: Who must wear a safety belt in a moving vehicle?
questions.explanation: In Utah, everyone in the vehicle must wear a safety belt. Drivers can be cited if they or any passenger under 16 are not wearing one. Passengers 16 and older can also be cited if not wearing a safety belt.

questions.question: How does alcohol affect you?
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects your brain's judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, hurts your coordination, and weakens your vision and ability to judge distance.

questions.question: When is it important to slow down?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections, at railroad crossings, on hills, on sharp curves, near pedestrians, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: What should drivers do when approaching a stopped school bus with its stop arm extended?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait to proceed.
Honk their horn before passing the bus on its left.
Continue driving when they think most kids are done exiting the bus.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait to proceed.
questions.explanation: Come to a complete stop when you see a school bus with its stop arm out. Do not move until the stop arm is put away.

questions.question: Are construction work zone signs orange?
questions.explanation: Construction zone signs are usually orange and diamond-shaped. Many are reflective to be more visible at night.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and carpools with a driver and at least one passenger.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers about a steep hill coming up. Slow down to avoid brake damage or accidents.

questions.question: Drivers should keep a safe distance from cyclists.
questions.explanation: Always keep a safe distance between your vehicle and cyclists.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on a green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on green that they do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass first.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar car from a friend. You should:

options.text: Not worry because all cars are the same.
Hide from your friend that you don't know the car.
Ignore any problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Spend a few minutes learning where everything is and how it works before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spend a few minutes learning where everything is and how it works before driving.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar car, take time to find the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn. Fix any problems before driving.

questions.question: You had an upsetting incident at work and feel angry. When you reach your car, you should:

options.text: Play loud radio music so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the highway to let off steam.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
Stop at a bar and drink before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait until you calm down before driving. Driving while upset is dangerous to you and others on the road.

questions.question: When you approach railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate comes down.
Not worry about how many tracks you need to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop for trains or other vehicles at railroad tracks.

questions.question: When driving on major highways, you should:

options.text: Be ready to react to hazards.

questions.explanation: Stay alert on highways and be ready to react to unexpected hazards. Keep your eyes moving and avoid looking at one thing too long to prevent highway hypnosis.

questions.question: On a freeway, you realize you missed your turn or exit. You should:

options.text: Continue to the next exit or safe place where you can turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to the next exit or safe place where you can turn around.
questions.explanation: If you miss your exit, continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around. Never back up on a freeway or shoulder.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in that direction.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from the task of driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. When you see this sign, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: If someone is driving aggressively behind you, what should you do?

options.text: Try to get out of the aggressive driver's way.
Stare at the driver as he or she is passing you.
Speed up as he or she is passing you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Try to get out of the aggressive driver's way.
questions.explanation: When you meet an aggressive driver, move out of their way. Do not look at them. Do not speed up, as this may make them angrier and more dangerous.

questions.question: If you miss your freeway exit, what should you do?

options.text: Make a U-turn through the median.
Pull onto the shoulder and back your car to the exit.
Flag down a police officer for an escort back to your exit.

questions.explanation: If you miss your exit, take the next one. Do not stop, back up, cross multiple lanes at the last second, or cross the median. These moves are illegal and very dangerous.
